import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
print("=== Starting Fresh Build on VPS ===")
# Check if pnpm is installed
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("which pnpm")
pnpm = stdout.read().decode().strip()
print("pnpm location:", pnpm)
if not pnpm:
    print("Installing pnpm...")
    stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("npm install -g pnpm")
    print(stdout.read().decode())
    print(stderr.read().decode())
# Install dependencies
print("\n=== Installing dependencies (this may take a while) ===")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile 2>&1 &")
print("Install started in background, PID:", stdout.read().decode())
# Give it 30 seconds then check
print("Waiting 30s...")
time.sleep(30)
# Check if still running
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ps aux | grep pnpm")
print("\n=== PM Install processes ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
